title: Grudge Match
html:
Quest Giver: Colonel Cabo

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Go to the MutantMania Massacre and fight Menacing Manglefeet the Murderous. Convince Manglefeet's manager to not schedule another fight so soon. Return to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center when done.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Colonel Cabo

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to the MutantMania Massacre and fight Menacing Manglefeet the Murderous. Convince Manglefeet's manager to not schedule another fight so soon. Return to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center when done.

Offer:

Sure, you're the newest title holder in the MutantMania Massacre championship, but that doesn't mean you can soak all day like Hershel the Hitter. Friend, you have to defend your title...or you lose it.

Speaking of losing a title, Menacing Manglefeet the Murderous didn't take his last defeat so well. He's still...Ah say, he's still fuming from every orifice. Ah scheduled another fight between the two of you. Go to the MutantMania Massacre arena and make sure Manglefeet doesn't get his title back. And, while you're taking care of Manglefeet, convince his manager that it's not a good idea to schedule these follow-up matches as quickly as he has been.

Turn-in:

You defeated...Ah say, you defeated Manglefeet *again*? How many times is that now? Ah'm beginning to lose track! You perform miracles, friend. Ah'll set up another re-match whenever you're ready.

Now, if you'll excuse me...Ah need to talk with the MutantMania's newest competitor, who I just saw coming through the entrance. Door, that is.

Objectives:

  • Defeat Menacing Manglefeet the Murderous
  • Convince Manglefeet's Manager

Client level range: 90–100
